_comments.README: This provides a way to check in notes related to this config. Please add notes as needed, especially for workarounds that should be removed
_comments.config: The config/ wrappers extend @labkey/build's rspack configs with the overrides JBrowse needs. Override 1: output.publicPath 'auto' instead of './'. Override 2: DefinePlugin inlines process.env. Override 3: dev builds bundle production React (see comment in config/dev.config.js).

scripts.build-dev: npm run clean && cross-env NODE_ENV=development rspack build --config config/dev.config.js
scripts.build-prod: npm run clean && cross-env NODE_ENV=production rspack build --config config/prod.config.js
scripts.clean: rimraf resources/web/gen && rimraf resources/web/jbrowse/gen && rimraf resources/views/gen
scripts.jb-sea: npm run jb-sea:fetch && npm run jb-sea:build
